offer.title: Want a quick tour?
offer.body: {total} short stops show you where things are. It takes about a minute. You can skip it now, or close it at any point.

modes.title: Your tools live here
modes.bodyOne: Chat is home. Below it is your tool: {tools}. Pick it to start.
modes.bodyList: Chat is home. Below it are your {count} tools: {tools}. Pick one to start.
modes.bodyMany: Chat is home. Below it is a tool for each kind of work. Pick one to start.
modes.bodyNone: Chat is home. You can add tools to this desk from Workspaces.

workspaces.title: Add more tools any time
workspaces.bodyMore: Want more tools, like {tools}? Open Workspaces, choose Edit on your desk, and switch them on. You can change it whenever you like.
workspaces.bodyAll: Every tool is already on this desk. To have fewer, open Workspaces, choose Edit on your desk, and switch some off. You can change it whenever you like.

chat.title: Ask Chat anything
chat.body: In Chat, type in the box at the bottom and press Enter. The model picker lets you choose which model answers.

knowledge.title: Teach it what you know
knowledge.body: The Knowledge Base keeps your notes, files and web pages. Chat uses them when it answers.

settings.title: Your key and your language
settings.body: Settings holds your key and your language. You can replay this guide from there whenever you like.

replay.title: Guide
replay.body: A one-minute walk through the rail, Workspaces, Chat, the Knowledge Base and Settings.
